chapter: Hutto 1978-79: family, favorites and record lists
title: Going through the Georgians records and Eddie Cantor
summary: Hutto reads Georgians titles from the collector's list and Morehouse says which he remembers, including several records with Eddie Cantor.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Okay. And here are some others he has, as far as the Georgians are concerned. Your first one - "I Wish I could Shimmy Like My Sister Kate", December 1929.
(SINGS A FEW BARS OF ABOVE SONG)
Do you, the Georgian?
Yes some Georgian records which I have. you have "Long Lost Mama" and "Henpecked Blues". Now you may have some others.
Yeah, I remember both of those.
Do you think you have that or not?
Do you remember what we have of Sister Kate? Maybe it's a Whiteman record.
"Sister Kate was a big hit," you know.
Do you also have the next one, "Way Down Yonder in New Orleans?"
Yeah.
And "Nothing But Jokes," Cardo came in on that.
Put a check on that.
I see. "Aggravating Papa." Do you remember that?
No, I don't remember that.
I remember that.
You Tell Her I Stutter.
I remember that.
"Snake Hips".
"Snake Hips," yes.
That's a good one. "Old King Tut and Barney Google".
Oh boy, we've got to hear those.
Well, 'Henpecked and Lost Mama,' you may have a better copy. 'Mama Goes Where Papa Goes' or 'Somebody is Wrong.'
I don't remember that.
Do you remember that?
Often we played it, yes I remember it very well.
Okay, this one I have from another fellow. And we might get another copy and it's very good. 'I'm Sitting Pretty On A Pretty Little City.' Do you remember that?
I don't remember that.
'Learn to do the Strut', Irving Berlin?
"Learn to Do the Strut," I remember that.
I've got that on the tape I brought.
Oh wonderful.
"Hometown Blues".
"Hometown Blues?"
"Shake Your Feet."
"Shake Your Feet?"
You don't remember that.
That's too long ago.
"Lovey Came Back" and "Dancing Dan".
My Lover Came Back to Me.
No, that was with Eddie Cantor.
That would be one with Eddie Cantor. He doesn't have that. Do you remember that? Recording with Eddie Cantor.
I made several records with Eddie Cantor.
"Oh Gee, Oh Georgie." "If You Do-What You Do."
Oh really, we've got to get that.
Well I'll tell you. He doesn't have that. I just mentioned Eddie Cantor. "Savannah", "Doodles, Doodle Do", "Doodle Doo Doo". Do you remember that?
Yeah, I remember that.
"Everybody Loves My Baby."
(SINGS) "Everybody loves my baby...."
That was about the last one you made.
